turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
Sure, I can help with that! Here’s an example from a casual conversation between friends:

Friend A: "Did you watch the game last night?"

Friend B: "Yeah, but I was so tired after work, I couldn’t stay up too late."

Friend A: "Yeah, I know what you mean. Sorry if my call came at a bad time."

In this case, "Yeah" is used to acknowledge Friend B's statement about watching the game. "Sorry" is an apology for possibly interrupting or calling at a bad time, not just a polite filler.
